Definition: Amminadab, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Amminadab = "my kinsman is noble"; 1) son of Ram or Aram and father of Nahshon or Naasson and an ancestor of Jesus; father-in-law of Aaron; 2) a Kohathite Levite and chief of the sons of Uzziel; 3) a Levite, son of Kohath; also 'Izhar'
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
